messages.content: Create a small screened canopy centered at the origin. Its ground platform is 6 by 3.2 m and 18 cm thick. Above it put a separate flat 5.8 by 3 m roof, 16 cm thick, with its underside 2.7 m above ground. Support the roof on two rows of five circular 12 cm diameter columns, at Z=-1.2 and +1.2 m; within each row the column centers run from X=-2.6 to +2.6 m at equal spacing. Add a rear privacy screen of 21 separate vertical rectangular fins, 8 cm along X and 18 cm along Z, centered at Z=-1.35 m and equally spaced from X=-2.6 to +2.6 m. Columns and fins extend from the platform surface to the roof underside. Keep all 33 parts independently editable and grouped. Leave the existing samples alone.
